meta.name: marketing-ideas
meta.description: When the user needs marketing ideas, inspiration, or strategies for their SaaS or software product. Also use when the user asks for 'marketing ideas,' 'growth ideas,' 'how to market,' 'marketing strategies,' 'marketing tactics,' 'ways to promote,' 'ideas to grow,' 'what else can I try,' 'I don't know how to market this,' 'brainstorm marketing,' or 'what marketing should I do.' Use this as a starting point whenever someone is stuck or looking for inspiration on how to grow. For specific channel execution, see the relevant skill (ads, social, emails, etc.).

copy.tagline: 获取SaaS产品的营销灵感与增长策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正为SaaS产品寻找营销方向和增长灵感。
copy.tagline_en: Get marketing ideas and growth strategies for your SaaS product.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're looking for marketing direction and growth inspiration for your SaaS product.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会扮演营销策略师，根据你的产品、阶段和资源，从 139 个营销点子中推荐 3-5 个最合适的，并给出实施步骤和预期效果。
howto.when: 当你询问 SaaS 或软件产品的营销想法、策略，或说出“营销点子”“增长思路”“怎么推广”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我的 SaaS 产品刚上线，预算很少，怎么推广？
say.note: Claude 会推荐低预算的营销点子，如内容营销、社区建设。

say.text: 我需要快速获取潜在客户，有什么好方法？
我们想通过内容建立权威，该从哪开始？
say.note: Claude 会推荐会议演讲、播客、出书等建立权威的方式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a marketing strategist. Based on your product, stage, and resources, it recommends 3-5 most relevant ideas from a library of 139 proven marketing ideas, with implementation steps and expected outcomes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for marketing ideas, strategies, or growth tactics for a SaaS or software product, or use keywords like 'marketing ideas,' 'growth ideas,' 'how to market,' etc.

say_en.text: My SaaS product just launched with a tiny budget. How can I promote it?
I need to generate leads quickly. What should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend fast-acting tactics like Google Ads or LinkedIn Ads.

say_en.text: We want to build authority through content. Where do we start?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest conference speaking, podcasting, or book marketing.
